headline_seed: Apple was surprised by AI-driven demand for Macs
description_seed: Apple said it will be supply-constrained on Mac Mini, Studio, and Neo in the next quarter, too.

what: Apple was surprised by AI-driven demand for Macs

clean_source_blocks.text: Apple said it will be supply-constrained on Mac Mini, Studio, and Neo in the next quarter, too.
Apple’s iPhone sales and Services revenue were the stars of the show in the tech giant’s most recent quarter, but the Mac quietly outperformed — helped by growing demand for AI workloads.

The $599 M4 Mac mini has disappeared from Apple’s shelves, only to resurface on eBay at above-retail prices as AI buyers chase one of the cheapest routes into local computing. The jump, first reported by TechCrunch, follows rising demand for compact machines that can run on-device AI models as Apple’s own supply dries up.
Apple has quietly removed several high-memory configurations of the Mac mini and Mac Studio from its U.S. online store over the weekend.
